status: Demonstrated via constructed exercise (not a real occurrence) -- see reason below
reason_no_real_occurrence: resolvePreMergeVerdict's STAGE1_CORRECTION_REQUIRED verdict now covers two deterministic pre-merge correction triggers: a findings-bearing Stage 1 response at the current head, or a merge-ready closing-reference violation (lifecycle-gate.mjs checkMergeReady returning BLOCKED_CLOSING_REFERENCE). No PR in this repository's current history is live in the specific closing-reference-violation state used by this exercise (the standing rule against Fixes/Closes/Resolves keywords in review-worthy LDL PR bodies makes this defect rare), so this scenario remains a constructed replay for that path.

violations.detail: PR LouPineWays/Loop-Dee-Loup#999999 carries a GitHub closing reference ... to issue #999998.

observation: The shipped resolvePreMergeVerdict function resolves a findings-bearing Stage 1 response and/or a closing-reference violation to STAGE1_CORRECTION_REQUIRED while keeping the correction transition reference-only (PR/issue refs, no restated finding narrative). For a new head with no review trigger yet, stage1-gate still reports NOT_REQUESTED and this gate stays NO_ACTION_YET; correction does not auto-authorize from stale free-text status.
